items.name: cyber
items.title: Cyber
items.description: Sets a project up for the cyberspec kit: the <Cyber> root, the foundation stylesheets (tokens, the cut-corner frame system, effects, shared field and popup looks), the fonts, and the page-wide behaviors the components rely on (the FX level, sampled and synthesized interface sounds, haptics, keyboard-or-pointer focus tracking, and the signal shown when an agent changes something).
items.docs: Wrap your app (or any part of it) in <Cyber> from @/components/ui/cyber; everything inside is styled by the skin. Set accent={{ l: 0.82, c: 0.13, h: 215 }} for another accent color (OKLCH), and fx="calm" or "off" to pin the effects level. Add data-crt="" once on the outer app root for a static screen raster and subtle corner vignette at full FX. Rajdhani and JetBrains Mono are imported at the top of your CSS file.
